The '''''Worthless Fool''''' was a [[VR-10 Cuirilla-Rayl Xylines-class spacetug|VR-10 ''Cuirilla-Rayl Xylines''-class spacetug]] belonging to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. It was [[Captain/Legends|captained]] by [[Maytoc Kollene]].

Its crew traveled to [[Najarka]], the [[Laim system/Legends|Laim system]], and [[Narg]] to rescue artist [[Crying Dawn Singer]] from the clutches of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. This earned them the respect of the [[Shashay]] species.
